title: Output Schema for Request Cached Messages Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace requestCachedMessages operation.

payload.description: The list of cached message summaries returned by the broker's PubSub+ Cache for the requested topic pattern.

items.description: A summary of a single cached message.

messageId.description: The broker-assigned message id. Present only when set.

topic.description: The topic the cached message was published to. Present only when the message carried a destination.

applicationMessageId.description: The application-defined message id. Present only when set.

receiveTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was received. Present only when non-zero.

senderTimestamp.description: Sender-supplied timestamp as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when set.

cacheRequest.description: Whether the message was delivered as part of a cache response (as opposed to live data).

payload.description: The message body as a UTF-8 string. Inspect contentType to determine how to interpret it.

contentType.description: The content type of the message payload (e.g., application/json, application/xml, text/plain).

cacheName.description: The name of the PubSub+ Cache Instance the request was issued against.

topicPattern.description: The topic pattern the cached messages were requested for.

messageCount.description: The number of cached messages returned.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
